dc:description: A complete corpus of 150 articles published in Meta-Psychology between 2018 and 2026 (all 153 CrossRef-registered articles minus 3 editorials), converted to metacheck paperlist objects for validation of AI and text-mining tools. Meta-Psychology checks the computational reproducibility of accepted articles; the manifest records the article type, open data/materials/code/analysis status, preregistration status, and who reproduced the analysis, as printed on each article's first page.

dc:provenance.doi_source: CrossRef REST API, ISSN 2003-2714 (complete corpus, no sampling); 153 records, identical to the 153 articles on the journal's issue pages
dc:provenance.sampling: none -- all 153 journal-article records, 150 retained after excluding 3 editorials
dc:provenance.pdf_source: open.lnu.se, current PDF link read from each article page; CrossRef text-mining link as fallback (outdated for 7 articles)
dc:provenance.conversion_endpoint: https://grobidOrg-grobid.hf.space (TU/e server https://grobid.hti.ieis.tue.nl not reachable outside the TU/e network)
dc:provenance.header_fields: first-page open-science fields read with pdftools::pdf_text()
dc:provenance.doi_matching: DOIs overwritten from CrossRef; papers matched by file name
dc:provenance.quality_audit: 3 editorials excluded, 3 empty GROBID titles filled from CrossRef, 5 PDFs print a mistaken DOI on page 1 (checked by hand, correct articles), 0 conversion failures, 0 duplicates, 0 papers without text, references or authors
